segments.text: This video demonstrates the donning and doffing of the following PPE.
segments.zh: 本视频演示以下个人防护装备的穿戴和脱卸：

segments.text: Laboratory coats, gloves, and safety glasses with wraparound sides.
segments.zh: 实验服、手套，以及带包围式侧护的安全眼镜。

segments.text: The first step is to remove personal items such as jewelry, watches, coats, jackets, cell phones, pens, or additional bags,
segments.zh: 第一步是取下个人物品，比如首饰、手表、外套、夹克、手机、笔或其他包，

segments.text: and place them in a location outside of the laboratory.
segments.zh: 把它们放在实验室外的某个地方。

segments.text: Then, tie back any long hair if present.
segments.zh: 然后，如果有长发，要把头发扎起来。

segments.text: Next, gather your laboratory coat with tight cuffs, gloves, and safety glasses with wraparound sides.
segments.zh: 接下来，准备好袖口收紧的实验服、手套和带包围式侧护的安全眼镜。

segments.text: Make sure you have the right size laboratory coat and gloves,
segments.zh: 确保实验服和手套的尺码合适，

segments.text: and don't forget to visually inspect all of your PPE for rips, tears, or missing snaps.
segments.zh: 别忘了目视检查所有个人防护装备，看有没有破口、撕裂或缺失的按扣。

segments.text: Next, put on the laboratory coat and snap it completely.
segments.zh: 接下来，穿上实验服，并把按扣全部扣好。

segments.text: Then, put on your safety glasses, and finally, put on your gloves.
segments.zh: 然后戴上安全眼镜，最后戴上手套。

segments.text: There are various strategies for establishing the sequence of doffing PPE.
segments.zh: 确定个人防护装备脱卸顺序的策略有很多种。

segments.text: The strategy demonstrated in this video is to remove PPE from most contaminated to least contaminated.
segments.zh: 本视频演示的策略是按照从污染最严重到污染最轻的顺序脱卸个人防护装备。

segments.text: To doff your PPE, the first step is to slowly and gently remove your gloves.
segments.zh: 脱卸个人防护装备时，第一步是缓慢、轻柔地摘下手套。

segments.text: Start by making an L with your thumb and first finger.
segments.zh: 先用拇指和食指摆成一个 L 形。

segments.text: Then, place your fingers perpendicular to your wrist and pinch.
segments.zh: 然后把手指垂直于手腕放置并捏住。

segments.text: Be careful to not touch the cuff of the coat with your dirty glove.
segments.zh: 注意不要用脏手套碰到实验服的袖口。

segments.text: Next, pull the glove completely off.
segments.zh: 接下来，把手套完全脱下来。

segments.text: It should now be inside out.
segments.zh: 这时它应该是里朝外翻过来的。

segments.text: Grab the inside-out glove with your bare hand, the one the glove just came off of,
segments.zh: 用刚脱下手套的那只裸手抓住这只翻过来的手套，

segments.text: and then pinch the other glove at the wrist.
segments.zh: 然后在手腕处捏住另一只手套。

segments.text: Then, pull the pinched glove up high and away from the wrist.
segments.zh: 接着把捏住的手套向上拉高，远离手腕。

segments.text: Pull the glove off, making sure the gloved hand is flat
segments.zh: 把手套脱下来，确保戴手套的那只手保持平展，

segments.text: and you do not touch the outside of the contaminated glove with your clean hand.
segments.zh: 并且不要用干净的手碰到被污染手套的外表面。

segments.text: And last, discard the gloves into the biohazard waste container.
segments.zh: 最后，把手套丢进生物危害废物容器。

segments.text: Remember, do not reuse the gloves.
segments.zh: 记住，手套不要重复使用。

segments.text: Take care to not touch the potentially contaminated outside surfaces of your laboratory coat with your bare hands.
segments.zh: 注意不要用裸手碰到实验服可能被污染的外表面。

segments.text: The cuffs of the coat should be clean, however, as the gloves extended over them during your work.
segments.zh: 不过实验服的袖口应该是干净的，因为工作时手套盖在袖口外面。

segments.text: Next, unsnap your laboratory coat and grasp the sleeve cuff of one of the arms and pull off the laboratory coat.
segments.zh: 接下来，解开实验服的按扣，抓住一只手臂的袖口，把实验服脱下来。

segments.text: Do the same for the other arm.
segments.zh: 另一只手臂也同样操作。

segments.text: If you are reusing the laboratory coat, hang the laboratory coat in a designated area.
segments.zh: 如果实验服要重复使用，就把它挂在指定区域。

segments.text: Please note, if there is visible contamination or it is determined that the laboratory coat should be disposed of,
segments.zh: 请注意，如果有可见污染，或者确定实验服应该丢弃，

segments.text: with the inside of the coat facing towards you,
segments.zh: 就让实验服的内面朝向你，

segments.text: fold the coat away from you and roll it inside out into a bundle,
segments.zh: 把它向外折叠，里朝外卷成一团，

segments.text: then dispose of it in the biohazard waste container.
segments.zh: 然后丢进生物危害废物容器。

segments.text: Next, remove your safety glasses by grasping the frames at the temples.
segments.zh: 接下来，抓住镜框的镜腿部位摘下安全眼镜。

segments.text: This is an area where there is less potential for contamination.
segments.zh: 这个部位被污染的可能性较小。

segments.text: Place them in a designated area to be disinfected at the end of the shift.
segments.zh: 把眼镜放在指定区域，在班次结束时消毒。

segments.text: Remember to use gloves and cleaning products that meet the EPA's approval to clean your safety glasses
segments.zh: 记住，清洁安全眼镜时要戴手套，并使用符合 EPA 认可的清洁产品，

segments.text: and follow the manufacturer's recommendations for contact time.
segments.zh: 还要遵循制造商建议的接触时间。

segments.text: Last, wash your hands with soap and water.
segments.zh: 最后，用肥皂和水洗手。

segments.text: Lather the backs of your hands, between your fingers and under your nails, and scrub for at least 20 seconds.
segments.zh: 把手背、指缝和指甲下面都打上泡沫，搓洗至少 20 秒。

segments.text: An alcohol-based hand sanitizer containing at least 60% ethanol or 70% isopropanol
segments.zh: 在有肥皂和水之前，可以临时使用含至少 60% 乙醇或 70% 异丙醇的

segments.text: can be used as a temporary solution until soap and water are available.
segments.zh: 酒精类免洗手消毒剂。

segments.text: Additional considerations
segments.zh: 其他注意事项：

segments.text: Closed-toed shoes with solid and impermeable uppers should be worn in the laboratory.
segments.zh: 在实验室里应穿鞋面结实、不透水的包头鞋。

segments.text: PPE will vary based on laboratory-specific and procedure-specific risk assessments.
segments.zh: 个人防护装备会根据各实验室和各操作程序的风险评估而有所不同。

segments.text: Donning and doffing areas should be physically separated from each other
segments.zh: 穿戴区和脱卸区应在物理上相互隔开，

segments.text: to avoid contamination of clean PPE and personal belongings with potentially contaminated PPE.
segments.zh: 以免可能被污染的个人防护装备污染干净的个人防护装备和个人物品。

segments.text: Donning and doffing procedures vary per institution.
segments.zh: 各机构的穿戴和脱卸程序各不相同。

segments.text: Follow your institutional policies and procedures.
segments.zh: 请遵循你所在机构的政策和程序。

segments.text: For additional training and workforce development resources, please visit cdc.gov slash labtraining
segments.zh: 如需更多培训和人员发展资源，请访问 cdc.gov/labtraining，

segments.text: and click on the Job Aids button.
segments.zh: 并点击“Job Aids”（工作辅助资料）按钮。
